about_the_game:
Hunted hunter is a single-player and a multi-player game (from 2 to 10 players) in which you'll have to take the form of objects on the game map, to blend into the background,


Single-player:

Hunted Hunter's single-player mode involves traversing various procedurally-generated dungeons.

Your objective will be to achieve the highest possible score, killing enemies, collecting crystals and opening chests to earn points.

There are 3 difficulty levels (Easy, Normal and Hard).

Can you beat your friends' scores?


Multiplayer game:

The aim is not to be spotted by other players, but to eliminate them before being eliminated yourself, as everyone hunts everyone else.

To eliminate your opponents, you have 3 grenades, which do very little damage, and a sword that eliminates your opponent in a single blow.


Each body part can be customized with 10 colors.

The maximum time for each game is 15 minutes, and if there's no winner before then, the game ends.


You can play with the joystick or the keyboard/mouse.

Hide well, win games and have fun!
